proposed_capability: P92 repository home page operator-clickable local installer/uninstaller: lazily open Tkinter GUI with Install/Uninstall buttons when bootstrap.py launched without args or with gui; require explicit uninstall confirmation; preserve existing CLI, manifest-owned safe cleanup and canonical paths. No remote web page may directly execute host software.
player_save_control_impact: Local UI is opt-in and explicit. Uninstall requires confirmation and uses existing manifest and clean-clone guards. No background watcher, PATH, registry, Mods, save or service mutations.
expected_outcome: Double-clicked trusted bootstrap.py opens a small local button UI with Install, Uninstall and Inspect Paths; CLI stays intact. README links directly to same trusted file and commands; unsupported Tkinter falls back to documented CLI without deleting anything.
negative_tests: Opening GUI without confirmation does not mutate workstation
Uninstall still refuses modified checkout or tampered manifest
Headless or missing Tkinter reports CLI fallback without mutation
File URL/GitHub page cannot execute code or bypass user OS authorization
rollback_path: Revert this GUI-only PR; command-line bootstrap and earlier canonical lifecycle remain on main.
unresolved_unknowns: Actual workstation Tkinter availability and user OS file associations require local check
